description: Call this BEFORE signing any crypto transaction or x402 payment request. Returns PASS / CAUTION / BLOCK with typed reasons, the checks that actually ran, the checks that did not, and a short-lived receipt bound to the exact intent + block. If sign_allowed is false, DO NOT SIGN. If requires_ack is true, surface the reasons to the operator before signing. The receipt expires (default 90s): call again rather than reuse it. Free. Pass `from` (the wallet that will sign) to enable simulation and balance checks. For kind=transaction, chainId is REQUIRED (400 missing_chain without it). For payment intents with no `from` or no proof, the response is PASS with structural_only:true and names what was not checked. Optional caller-supplied checks: policy.sellerPayoutWallets is a payout allowlist, not provenance; policy.sellerPayoutManifest fetches a seller-signed manifest from a caller-pinned HTTPS origin and is the only source of payee_payout_binding; policy.obligation checks a local settled-key ledger and cumulative spend against a grant. The gate does not persist either state.

chainId.description: EVM chain id: 1 Ethereum, 42161 Arbitrum, 8453 Base. For payment, cross-checks the network.

from.description: The wallet that will sign. Strongly recommended: enables simulation and balance checks.

kind.description: payment = an x402 402 challenge; transaction = a chain transaction

amount.description: RAW amount in the asset's smallest unit, as a string

asset.description: Token address or mint, e.g. canonical USDC on that network

extra.description: x402 extra fields: validAfter / validBefore / facilitator

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-local payment idempotency key (not the paid-route x-idempotency-key header); enables the policy.obligation replay check

network.description: CAIP-2 network, e.g. "eip155:84532" for the public demo or "solana:..."

resource.description: The resource URL the payment is for

policy.description: Operator policy. Omit for structural checks only.

allowedResourceHosts.description: Bare hostnames allowed in payment.resource; a foreign host is BLOCK

expectedResource.description: The exact resource URL the agent intends to pay for

forbidUnlimitedApproval.description: Turn an unlimited approve into a BLOCK

maxAmountUsd.description: Reject payments above this USD value

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Reject challenges with a longer timeout

maxValueEth.description: Reject native value above this ETH amount

maxValueWei.description: Reject native value above this wei amount

obligation.description: Caller-supplied local obligation state. The public gate does not persist it

grantUsd.description: Total grant in USD; spentUsd and grantUsd must be supplied together

spentUsd.description: Already spent under the grant, in USD

sellerPayoutManifest.description: Seller-signed payout manifest; the only source of payee_payout_binding

expectedSigner.description: Optional EVM address pin for the manifest signer

url.description: HTTPS URL of a seller-signed manifest outside the 402

sellerPayoutWallets.description: Caller-supplied seller payout allowlist; a payTo mismatch is BLOCK. This is not provenance and never adds payee_payout_binding

value.description: Native value in wei, as a decimal string

name: preflight_gate
